conclusion: lambda=1 alone worsened final deterministic D in all three paired pilots; do not adopt it as the fix.
mechanism_observed: Larger raw return/advantage spread and critic gradient norm, all minibatches clipped at lambda=1; argmax concentration remains.
causal_limit: Clip dominance does not prove actor starvation; Adam rescales individual parameter updates. GAE horizon and target variance change together.
recommended_next: Separate pilot diagnosis of actor-critic target/loss scale and clipping; retain deterministic evaluation and no test access.
prefix_scope: Pilot budget only; no lambda=1 production F checkpoint reuse certification.
